extraction_notes: Single-part datasheet from Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com); top-level manufacturer preserves the exact job identity hongjiacheng.

Curves were digitized programmatically from a 300 dpi render of page 2 with pixel calibration against the printed axis frames and gridlines (Fig. 1: VF 0-0.6 V linear at 130.5 px per 0.1 V, IF 0.1-1000 mA log at 173.25 px/decade; Fig. 2: VR 0-30 V linear at 130.8 px per 5 V, IR 0.1-1000 uA log at 173.5 px/decade; Fig. 3: VR 0.1-100 V log at 261 px/decade, CT 1-1000 pF log at 230 px/decade). Every decade and minor gridline position was cross-checked against the calibration before reading points, and all sampled points were verified by rendering them back over the source figures.

Fig. 3's y-axis is not anchored at the plot frame: the 1000 pF gridline sits about 33 px below the frame top (chart headroom above 1000 pF), so the axis was calibrated bottom-anchored at 1 pF with 230 px/decade, validated against all minor gridlines of every decade.

In Fig. 1 the Ta = 25 degC curve is printed in gray and the Ta = 100 degC curve in black; the two traces were separated by pixel tone (gray core ~63/255 vs black ~0-15/255), which cleanly disambiguates them where they converge at low current.
Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 y-values were converted from the printed mA and uA axis units to SI amperes, and Fig. 3 y-values from pF to farads.
The digitized Fig. 1 25 degC typical curve reads 0.338 V at IF = 0.1 A and ends near IF = 0.49 A at about 0.42 V, consistent with the table maxima of 0.36 V at 0.1 A and 0.47 V at 0.5 A.
The digitized Fig. 2 25 degC typical curve reads about 6.5 uA at VR = 20 V, consistent with the table maximum reverse current of 100 uA at VR = 20 V.
No capacitance row exists in the electrical characteristics table; the capacitance scalar is read from the Fig. 3 typical curve at VR = 4.0 V (38.3 pF = 3.83e-11 F).

Absolute maximum ratings on p. 1: VRRM = 30 V, VRMS = 20 V, VDC = 20 V, IF(AV) = 0.5 A, IFSM = 2.0 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine, PD = 250 mW, Tj = 125 degC, Tstg = -65 to +150 degC, RthJA = 400 degC/W. Note the p. 1 feature bullet claims VR = 30 V while the maximum-ratings table limits VRMS and VDC to 20 V; the electrical-characteristics reverse-current test condition (VR = 20 V) matches the rated DC blocking voltage. These ratings are not breakdown characterization data.
Fig. 4 is a power-derating rating curve, not a device IV or capacitance characteristic, and is not digitized.
extraction.omission_reason: The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time and no reverse-breakdown characterization; reverse_recovery, breakdown_voltage, and breakdown_current remain null.
